mainText: Futures are mixed this morning. The Dow is up half a percent, the S and P 500 is about flat, and the Nasdaq 100 is down half a percent. Stocks are cooling off after Wednesday's big post-midterm rally, when the Dow rose 3 percent and the Nasdaq rose one and four tenths percent. Money is rotating out of chip and A I names into the broader market, and oil fell more than 8 percent Wednesday. The 10 year Treasury yield is about 4.88 percent, down a few basis points from Wednesday's close near 4.91 percent. Big movers: Qualcomm is down 9 to 11 percent after smartphone chip sales missed estimates, with handset revenue down 26 percent. Arm is down more than 4 percent despite an earnings beat. Unity is up 23 percent. Chip stocks are broadly lower, including Nvidia, Intel, A M D, and Broadcom. Weekly jobless claims are out at 8:30, and the October jobs report comes Friday.
